top_signals.title: Stocks Rally on Strong Earnings; SpaceX's AI Spending Hits Shares | Bloomberg Brief 08/05/26
top_signals.summary: US equity futures gains after stocks closed at an all-time high for the first time since June. Shares of SpaceX extend its decline as the company's AI spending puts a damper on its debut earnings results. Oil rises after a new threat by the Houthi militant against Middle East shipping offsets optimism from President Trump about a potential US-Iran deal. Matt McLennan of First Eagle Investments discusses the resilience in US corporate profit margins. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
